_doc: Large batch L03 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

jungle-tiger/f:b1.note: Shade-Pounce Mangle: a mangle is jaws; also breaks the slash run (b0, b1, u1)

mandrill-boss/f:b1.note: Humourless Grab: a clamping grab reads as jaws; breaks the four-slash run

elder-tiger/f:b1.note: Grizzle Mangle: mangle = jaws; breaks the slash run (b0, b1, x0)

black-jaguar/f:b1.note: Downpour Maul: a maul is jaws and teeth; breaks the four-slash run

black-jaguar/f:u3.note: Night Drop: dropping from a branch onto the prey is a heavy landing, not a slash

black-jaguar/f:b2.note: Rain Crouch: art is rain, ripple rings; stops two plain shields (u2 is hold shield)

cloud-leopard/f:x0.note: Ledge Plunge: a plunge from a ledge is a drop-slam; breaks the slash run

cloud-leopard/f:u2.note: Long Tail: no tag and no keyword; a long tail trailing like a thread (best guess, default ripple is weaker)

cloud-leopard/f:u3.note: Rumour Step: whispery glints; stops a second puff next to Cloud Coat (best guess)

ghost-leopard/f:b1.note: Ghost Strike: one clean straight ghostly strike, lance; breaks the three-slash run

tufted-lynx/f:b1.note: Soft Paw Pin: pinning the prey down is a press, thump; breaks the four-slash run

snow-lynx/f:u0.note: Snow Leap: the leap kicks up a snow cloud; breaks the four-slash run

snow-lynx/f:b1.note: Lynx Drift Pounce: a heavy pounce landing in a drift, thump

snow-lynx/f:b2.note: Lynx Snowshoe: snow glitter round the wide paws; stops two shields (u2 is hold shield)

mischief-monkey/f:b1.note: Tail-Swing Bonk: a bonk is a thump, not a slash

mischief-monkey/f:b3.note: Pocket-Pick Pinch: pinch = nip; keyword beats the bash tag here (pinch, not a hit)

mischief-monkey/f:x0.note: Tree-Drop Slam: dropping out of the jungle canopy, leaves fall with him (best guess)

mischief-monkey/f:u1.note: Fruit Fling: thrown fruit splats into juice drops, not an electric zig

bearded-pig/f:b0.note: Bristle Root: rooting is the pointed snout driven in; leaf keyword is a false hit on 'root'

bearded-pig/f:x0.note: Bristle Ram: a ram is a head-first thump; breaks the slash run

bearded-pig/f:u1.note: Mud Plough: mud spatters off the snout, drops, not a zig (quick kept for speed)

bearded-pig/f:u3.note: Fruit Snatch: snatching with the mouth; breaks the four-slash run

bearded-pig/f:b2.note: Bristle Shield: a bristle coat of spines; stops two plain shields (u2 is hold shield)
